announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~55%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family still at ~20% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.6%), -15 for organic correction (Spellslinger: Broodscale share down ~19% to ~15% over 30 days, effective archetypes up 19 to 32; Broodscale won none of the last three RCs). x P(Command picked) ~30%: Emrakul, the Promised End or Blade of the Bloodchief are the narrower enablers and the consensus pick; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 20% of all Modern decks, which WotC avoids hitting.
#40 Legacy staple in ~12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. Since then the deck is still the most played (Eldrazi Ramp 11.6% on MTGGoldfish, Broodscale Bloodchief 13% on MTGTop8) but its share is falling and it won none of the last three Regional Championships, so a Nov 30 hit is about a coin flip. If WotC acts, Emrakul or Blade of the Bloodchief is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 606 decks: Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 13%, Eldrazi Ramp 0.7%; Rakdos Aggro 11%, Amulet Titan 7%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.6%; Eldrazi-family decks ~19.6% combined (Eldrazi 3.1%, Eldrazi Tron 2.6%, Broodscale 1.8%).

sources.title: Eldrazi Ramp (Mono-Green Eldrazi Broodscale)
sources.takeaway: Goldfish's Eldrazi Ramp is the Broodscale combo deck: 4 Kozilek's Command, 4 Eldrazi Temple, 4 Mycospawn, ~4 Emrakul in every list.

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #14 staple, 20% of decks as a 4-of; Emrakul #35 (16%), Blade of the Bloodchief #48 (13%).

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #40 Legacy staple, ~12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Regional Championship - MIT Championship (Taipei)
sources.takeaway: Won by Rakdos Delirium; one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8 (5-8th).

sources.title: Regional Championship - South America
sources.takeaway: Won by Boros Energy; Broodscale Bloodchief 2nd and 5-8th.

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.

sources.title: September '26 Metagame Update: Broodscale Blitz
sources.takeaway: 'If Broodscale is too good, it's the wrong card to ban'; Emrakul is the better target, a Command ban would kill the other Eldrazi decks.
